item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:25 HKT 30/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The tropical cyclone over the central part of the South China Sea will move in the general direction of the coast of western Guangdong in the next couple of days and intensify gradually. Winds will strengthen gradually with swells over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China. Its associated outer rainbands will also bring squally showers and thunderstorms to the region. Under the influence of an active southerly airstream, the weather is expected to remain unsettled over the coast of Guangdong next week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with squally showers and thunderstorms. There will be swells.
Temp range: 26 - 30 C

PSR: Medium High
